blocks.text: You can enable, disable, edit, delete, or validate an evidence rule as required.

blocks.item: Enabling or Disabling an Evidence Rule
You can enable or disable an evidence rule as required.

Evidence data is cached for 60 minutes. If you disable a rule, evidence data continues to be collected and stored for 60 minutes. When disabled, evidence collection is not started until the 60-minute cache is cleared.
To enable or disable an evidence rule:
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Evidence Settings.
Select the toggle under the Enable/Disable column to enable or disable the evidence rule.
See image.
Read the confirmation message that appears, then click Enable Evidence Setting or Disable Evidence Setting to apply the changes.
Editing an Evidence Rule
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Evidence Settings.
Click the Actions icon and select Edit.
See image.
On the Edit Evidence Rule page, modify the configuration as required.
Download and deploy the template on your account to grant access to the evidence bucket.
Click Done.
Deleting an Evidence Rule
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Evidence Settings.
Click the Actions icon and select Delete.
See image.
In the Delete Evidence Rule window, enter CONFIRM and click Delete.
Validating an Evidence Rule

DSPM validates the evidence rules every 4 hours to verify if the template is deployed and the connection to the S3 bucket via IAM role is successful. You can also manually validate to verify the connection. Evidence data is collected in the S3 bucket only if the DSPM connection is successful.
The Connection Status can be one of the following:
Success: The evidence template is deployed and DSPM connection to the S3 bucket is successful.
Pending: The evidence template is yet to be deployed or validation is incomplete.
Failed: DSPM failed to establish a connection to the S3 bucket (e.g., Template deployment failed, IAM role not created). You can view the details in the Error column.
To validate an evidence rule:
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Evidence Settings.
Click the Actions icon and select Validate.
See image.
A pop-up message appears confirming that the validation is initiated.
Based on the validation, the Connection Status is updated.
